correctness.rationale: For monic Q in Z[X] rational irreducible degree d>=2 splitting into d distinct mod-p linear factors, Hensel gives distinct irrational p-adic conjugate roots α_i. At each j, exactly d residue kernel subsequences are g_{i,j}(n)=j+ν_p(n-β_{i,j}); unmatched residues are constant, and a constant 1 first appears at depth 2. Affine rigidity precludes coincidences between all α_i and tails β_{i,j}: an irrational root cannot have a finite orbit under nontrivial positive p-power rational-affine action. Independent coefficient-isolation via nonnegative integers n approaching one p-adic irrational point shows valuation sequences and constant are Q-linearly independent. Consequently rank depth0=1, depth1=d+1, depth e>=2=de+2 for all e, with no finite-precision extrapolation. Independently calculated sample rational ranks 1,3,6 for Q=x²+1,p=5 at e=0,1,2.
